div.div:
Notes
*1 Four client tools
AWS CLI, s5cmd, rclone, and Mountpoint for Amazon S3. Checked on real hardware from an EC2 instance in ap-northeast-1 on 2026-11-24 and 2026-11-27 (one configuration, one run each).
*2 The copy was measured on real hardware in both directions
Bucket to volume and volume to bucket, with AWS CLI, s5cmd, and rclone. The documents say one Region only. Owner, mode, and modification time were not carried over (a Playbook measurement, root user configuration only).
*3 The AWS services in the frame are expectations from documents
Not checked on real hardware in this repository.
*4 Where the NFS / SMB clients run is not specified
The figure does not show VPC or on premises.
